gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Phase 3 Randomized Double-blind, Controlled Study of ICT-107 With Maintenance Temozolomide (TMZ) in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Following Resection and Concomitant TMZ Chemoradiotherapy
Subjects with glioblastoma mutated IDH by Immunohistochemistry (IHC)

candidate_evidence.quote: ICT-107 consists of dendritic cells, prepared from autologous mononuclear cells that are pulsed with six synthetic peptides that were derived from tumor associated antigens (TAA) present on glioblastoma tumor cells.
[BIOLOGICAL] ICT-107: Autologous dendritic cells pulsed with peptides associated with tumor antigens

candidate_flag.reason: Only investigational agent is a dendritic-cell vaccine (excluded type); temozolomide is standard-of-care backbone in both arms.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Following Resection and Concomitant TMZ Chemoradiotherapy

role_evidence.quote: Arm 1 will receive ICT-107 in combination with the standard of care, temozolomide (TMZ).

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous dendritic-cell cancer vaccine (excluded intervention type)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Reinfusion with the pulsed dendritic cells should stimulate cytotoxic T cells to specifically target glioblastoma tumour cells.

flag.reason: Dendritic-cell vaccine is an excluded intervention type; listed for transparency, not a pharmacological candidate.

role_evidence.quote: Subjects will be randomized to receive standard of care chemoradiation (temozolomide (TMZ) with either ICT-107 or a blinded control.

source_quote.quote: All subjects must have glioblastoma tissue that has tumor assessment for MGMT methylation status prior to randomization (for stratification).
Subjects with glioblastoma mutated IDH by Immunohistochemistry (IHC)

flag.reason: Exclusion of IDH-mutant tumours; IDH-wildtype used to define GBM.

source_quote.quote: Subjects must be HLA-A2 positive by central lab

flag.reason: HLA-A2 is required for the peptide-pulsed DC vaccine, but ICT-107 is an excluded intervention type, not a pharmacological candidate.

coder_notes: Phase 3 DC vaccine (ICT-107) vs autologous PBMC placebo, both with maintenance TMZ in newly diagnosed GBM. Fails S6: excluded intervention type. MGMT also used for secondary OS subgroup analyses.
